description: PAID $0.02 USDC. Price drops, price rises, restocks, sell-outs, new products and removals detected between daily crawls of 180+ Shopify stores. Filter by type (comma list), domain, category, brand, days (1-30), limit. Returns JSON crawl-to-crawl changes (price drops and rises, restocks, sell-outs, new products, removals) for the filters.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

brand.description: Optional brand name. Format: the brand string used by the store. Example: Allbirds. Omit for every brand.

category.description: Optional store category. Format: one of apparel, beauty, electronics, supplements, home, outdoor, jewelry, pets, toys, the list on ecom_snapshot. Example: beauty. Omit for every category.

days.description: How many days of crawl diffs. Format: integer from 1 to 30, as the tool text states. Example: 7. Omit for the server's current span.

domain.description: Optional store domain. Format: a hostname. Example: allbirds.com. Omit for every store.

limit.description: Maximum change rows. Format: positive integer. Example: 50. Omit for the server's current cap.

type.description: Comma-separated change types. Format: the values the tool text names: price_drop, price_rise, restock, sellout, new_product, removed. Example: price_drop,restock. Omit for every type.

name: ecom_changes
title: E-commerce price drops & restocks ($0.02)
